notes.title: Happy Birthday Pleh!
notes.content:
Wow, it's already been a year. 

Checking the steam page to see if there's any new Pleh! reviews has been a part of my morning routine for a year now, I've read every single review.

Thank you so much to everyone who played Pleh! I really do appreciate every single one of you <3

[previewyoutube=y7mv8UVvY3E;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Vote Pleh! for The Steam Awards!
notes.content:
I never expected Pleh! to get as big as it is. It's not massive, it's not the new game that everyone talks about, but I never expected the fan base it has today. With your help, we can surely get nominated for 

[h1][b]A STEAM AWARD![/b][/h1]
[i]specifically the story rich award I reckon that's our best shot[/i]

We're up against some big titles and every vote counts!

Let's be realistic, we're not going to get nominated, but we can still try!

Have a happy Autumn sale!

notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.7.0
notes.content:
Thanks for the amazing response to the content update! Glad everyone enjoyed :)
By the way, if for whatever reason you can't access the update from the pause menu, you can always type "10.17" anywhere in the game, then head behind you and press the grey button on your left as an alternative to launching through the pause menu.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that showed the old 15cubes.zip instead of the new 12cubes.zip in the developer console, making it impossible to get the other ending (no idea how that happened, weird)
[/list]

Also remember to check out the Knight In Time teaser trailer in case you missed it: https://youtu.be/fW7uZ7W2YYk

Please post any bugs or issues in [url=https://discord.com/invite/4AD4j7bA5Q]the discord server[/url] and enjoy!

notes.title: Knight In Time Teaser!
notes.content:
From the creators of Pleh! we are really excited to reveal our latest game:

[u][h3][h2][h1][b]Knight In Time[/b][/h1][/h2][/h3][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111490/0e840c54c7038b311463733c1e2b0a434783d08f.png[/img]

In this action-packed bullet hell game, Claymore the knight finds himself trapped in a dangerous, alien-infested future. He must save the world with only his courage, wits, and his limited understanding of how guns work.

[previewyoutube=fW7uZ7W2YYk;full][/previewyoutube]

Releasing: [spoiler]eventually[/spoiler]

P.S Check out the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2191550/announcements/detail/3729601044549807352]Pleh! content update[/url] if you haven't already.

notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.6.9
notes.content:
This is it, this is the update you've all been waiting for.

[list]
[*] [b]CONTENT UPDATE: A non-cannon, 10-minute segment has been added to the game. [/b] To play it, pause the game and press the "New Content!!!" button. You must have already beaten the game to unlock this. Please enjoy :)
[*] Fixed a bug in the house section that would black-screen the game.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to interact with objects while paused.
[*] Pausing the game now hides the cursor to make the pause menu not as confusing.
[*] Added a link to Pleh! 3 in the dev room.
[*] Small performance updates, nothing major.
[*] Updated the end credits and credits PDF.
[/list]

I've been working on this content update for the past month, it was really fun to come back to Pleh! after a few months and properly work on this game again. Aside from fixing bugs from this content update, there won't be any more major updates to this game. We're still working hard on Project Miles and have something to show in the very near future ;)

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for playing Pleh! 

What a wild ride it's been.

Please post any bugs or issues in [url=https://discord.com/invite/4AD4j7bA5Q]the discord server[/url] and enjoy!

notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.6.8
notes.content:
[list]

[/list]

That's all for Pleh!, but please note that we're still working on Project Miles and might possibly have something to showcase soon :D

Please post any bugs or issues in [url=https://discord.gg/invite/4AD4j7bA5Q]the discord server[/url] and enjoy!

notes.title: Pleh! is now open source!
notes.content:
Pleh! Is now open-sourced on GitHub for free, so you can go ahead and look at the source code, download the project, and do whatever you want with it. I fully support game developers looking for and getting inspired by other developers' code, so I really hope any other game devs out there find this useful. Feel free to download the project and get it running in Unity. 

[url=https://github.com/BLAZE4242/Pleh-Public-Edition]Check it out here![/url]

<3

notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.1.7
notes.content:

[list]
[*] Made default volume quieter (this will only affect people launching the game for the first time)

[*] Fixed a bug where a few sections of the game weren't impacted by volume slider (lightning and watching videos in a developer console, if you somehow managed to ever gain access to that)
[*] Speaking of that, I lost a bet and my friend Benji made me write this here: "Hey guys it's me benji, I added an update to my program so now it scales with the screen size its rly cool haha check it out stay cool 😎"
[*] Made the 10.17 achievement significantly easier to get
[/list]
